title: Standard Delivery & Proof of Fulfillment Policy
content: Orders confirmed delivered by carrier tracking with delivery timestamp and geo-coordinates/signature are protected under Merchant Seller Protection. Claims for 'Item Not Received' with carrier status 'Delivered' will be contested by submitting carrier tracking information and fulfillment logs within 10 days.

title: Significantly Not As Described (SNAD) Return Protocol
content: Items claimed as defective or not as described require buyer to initiate a return within 14 days of receipt in original condition. Merchant will offer replacement or partial refund upon inspection. For items under $25, instant replacement is preferred over return shipping costs.

title: Abuse & Repeat Claimant Handling Policy
content: Accounts demonstrating 2 or more unresolved dispute claims within a 90-day rolling window or dispute-to-order ratio exceeding 15% are flagged for manual security review. Automated concessions are denied for flagged accounts.
